title: Kodo Blueprint — kodo.blueprint.json
description: Versioned Phase 4 blueprint describing a multi-stack project: target stack, base package/namespace and the vertical slices (domain model + service dependencies) that the stack generator plugins render. The same contract is implemented in services/api-python/app/models/blueprint.py (Pydantic v2) and apps/web/src/types/blueprint.ts.

schemaVersion.description: Blueprint format version. Kodo rejects unknown versions instead of guessing.

projectName.description: Human readable project name; also drives the generated build/assembly name.

stack.description: Target stack whose generator plugin renders the slices.

basePackageOrNamespace.description: Java base package (com.acme.billing), C# root namespace (Acme.Desktop), the TypeScript source root (src) or the Python package root (app).

slices.description: Vertical slices rendered as Entity/Model + DTO + Repository + Service + Controller (+ test).

name.description: PascalCase domain name, e.g. Invoice or Customer.

dependsOnSlices.description: Other slice names this service depends on (must be defined in the same blueprint). Generates constructor-injected service-to-service dependencies.

includeTests.description: Emit the unit-test skeleton for this slice.

type.description: Canonical stack-aware type (string, text, email, int, long, decimal, boolean, date, datetime, uuid). Unknown values are emitted verbatim for power users.

annotations.description: Stack-specific validation presets, e.g. @Size(max = 120), @IsEmail(), [StringLength(120)]. Non-matching annotations are filtered per stack.
